# Agentic Private Office — Matthew Keddy

> The Agentic Private Office of Matthew Keddy. AI-native brands in capital markets, consumer and retail AI shopping, and pharma, generating 100M+ in AI agent and human traffic a month.

Operator: Agentic KG Holdings · Principal: Matthew Keddy · Surface: https://agent-kg.ai · Surface version 0.12.10 · as of 2026-11-18

## What it is

The Agentic Private Office of Matthew Keddy holds a portfolio of AI-native brands in three markets: capital markets, consumer and retail AI shopping, and pharma. Together they generate 100M+ in AI agent and human traffic a month, across global markets in the Americas, the EU and UK, and Asia.

IRL agent-ready data products: the record of real things, built for AI agents that act in real life. Not training data for the labs. Not synthetic data from a model. Real products, real issuers and real medicines, each with its source.

The record is served live on Model Context Protocol (MCP), in real time on Microsoft Azure across 20+ hyperscale cloud regions, with Amazon Web Services held as standby.

Products: AI-native Optimize, for agents already running, paid as they go on x402 machine payments. AI-native Design & Build, for enterprises building their own agents, by arrangement. RCO (Record of Cleared Orders), for compliance teams: a signed receipt for every read.

The private office of Matthew Keddy, published as a crawlable surface, an A2A party, an MCP door and an x402 counterparty. Sections 1–13 on the page.

## Holdings

- [WeFetch AI Corp.](https://wefetch.ai/) — consumer and retail AI shopping — keys held, through the office
- [Allooloo Technologies Corp.](https://allooloo.io) — capital markets — keys held, through the office
- [Dosidal AI Corp.](https://dosidal.ai/) — pharma — keys held, through the office
- [Family Office Knowledge Graph](https://familyofficeknowledgegraph.ai) — familyofficeknowledgegraph.ai

## Hyperscaler tenancies

- Microsoft Azure — two tenants.
- Google Cloud — two tenants.
- Amazon Web Services — two accounts, custodial.
- Cloudflare — four accounts, custodial, all zones.
- Ten hyperscaler tenancies in the portfolio, under agentic management.

- Agentic datapoints: 10BN

## Doors

- Page: https://agent-kg.ai/ (Markdown twin on Accept: text/markdown)
- Human contact: https://agent-kg.ai/#contact — the form is the only door on the page
- Paid door (x402 v2, $0.01 USDC, Base mainnet): GET https://agent-kg.ai/api → 402 offer; with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE → { receipt, statement, data }; human door https://agent-kg.ai/x402
- MCP door (streamable-http): https://agent-kg.ai/mcp — one tool, office_statement; card https://agent-kg.ai/.well-known/mcp.json
- OAuth: https://agent-kg.ai/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server (client_credentials to registered agents); licensed statement https://agent-kg.ai/licensed/statement; protected-resource metadata https://agent-kg.ai/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource; registration instructions https://agent-kg.ai/auth.md
- Holding attestation: GET https://agent-kg.ai/attest/{holding-host} — a line signed with the office key that the estate is the office's

## Machine kit

- https://agent-kg.ai/facts.json — office facts of record

- https://agent-kg.ai/.well-known/skills.json — skills with input/output shapes; https://agent-kg.ai/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json — skills index with digests
- https://agent-kg.ai/.well-known/jwks.json — office keyring, kid mk-office-2026-09; https://agent-kg.ai/x402/jwks.json — x402 receipt key, kid mk-office-x402-2026-09
- https://agent-kg.ai/.well-known/api-catalog — RFC 9727 linkset; https://agent-kg.ai/openapi.json — OpenAPI 3.1; https://agent-kg.ai/health.json — status

## Rulings

- 2026-09-13 — Multi-family office model, agentic in scope; one principal on this page.
- 2026-09-13 — The office mailbox is not published; the form is the door.
- 2026-09-13 — The office is the owner of record for the principal's cloud tenancies; identifiers stay in the private register.
- 2026-09-13 — The office holds no cryptocurrency. A key is a signature, not a wallet.
